title: Cooling Extreme Heat
description: Ways to cool your home and body without air conditioning, including when fans help and when they make things worse, plus sleeping in heat and protecting older adults, children, and pets. Includes heat illness signs and first aid, and when to go to a cooling center.
shortDescription: Cooling your home and body without AC, the 90°F fan limit, and when to leave
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
